sql: SELECT MIN(balance), MAX(balance) FROM accounts
SELECT balance, balance * 1.1 AS adjusted FROM accounts
SELECT *, CASE WHEN balance > 1000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance > 100 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS bucket FROM accounts
SELECT COALESCE(customer_id, 'N/A') FROM accounts
SELECT * FROM accounts c1 WHERE balance = (SELECT MAX(balance) FROM accounts c2 WHERE c2.customer_id = c1.customer_id)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT acct_no) FROM accounts
SELECT * FROM accounts CROSS JOIN branches LIMIT 20
WITH agg AS (SELECT acct_no, SUM(balance) FROM accounts GROUP BY acct_no) SELECT * FROM agg
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', opened_on) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM accounts GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT p.*, s.total FROM customers p JOIN (SELECT customer_id, SUM(balance) AS total FROM accounts GROUP BY customer_id) s ON p.id = s.customer_id
SELECT DISTINCT acct_no FROM accounts
SELECT id FROM customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM accounts
SELECT p.*, c.* FROM customers p LEFT JOIN accounts c ON p.id = c.customer_id
SELECT * FROM accounts ORDER BY id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10
SELECT a.*, b.*, c.* FROM accounts a JOIN customers b ON a.customer_id = b.id JOIN branches c ON b.branch_id = c.id
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT * FROM employees WHERE supervisor_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.* FROM employees s JOIN tree ON s.supervisor_id = tree.id) SELECT * FROM tree
SELECT a.*, b.* FROM employees a JOIN employees b ON a.supervisor_id = b.id
SELECT UPPER(acct_no) FROM accounts
SELECT * FROM customers p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts c WHERE c.customer_id = p.id)
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM accounts WHERE balance > 100)
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE balance > (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM accounts)
SELECT * FROM accounts ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT acct_no FROM accounts WHERE acct_no LIKE 'A%' UNION SELECT acct_no FROM accounts WHERE acct_no LIKE 'B%'
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE balance > 100 AND (acct_no = 'A' OR acct_no = 'B')
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE balance BETWEEN 100 AND 500
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE acct_no LIKE 'A%'
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE acct_no <> 'VALUE'
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE customer_id IS NULL
SELECT *, SUM(balance) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS running_total FROM accounts
SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance DESC) AS rn FROM accounts
